A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"br_in_tables\":true,\"compact_tables\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
